note: What each friend is actually in the middle of. An activity is a task with a snag and a reason; the reason is what makes elaboration personal instead of encyclopedic. Day-stable: the same friend has the same activity all day. Written by hand for now -- see docs/LIFE.md.

activities.doing: sanding the stock on an old 30-06 i picked up at a gun show
activities.short: up to my elbows in sawdust
activities.phase: third coat of oil and it is still tacky
activities.why: i liked the look of the wood

activities.doing: rebuilding the back fence before the weather turns
activities.phase: half the posts are rotted at the base
activities.why: the old one leaned for two years
activities.invite: you got anything falling apart at your place?

activities.doing: trying to get an old machine to boot off a disk i made myself
activities.phase: it gets to the boot screen and quits
activities.why: i want to know what it is doing

activities.doing: got the game on in the background
activities.phase: they are down one in the second
activities.why: it is the rangers, i am not stopping now

activities.doing: reading a book about the roman republic, slowly
activities.phase: the bit where everyone is related to everyone
activities.why: the politics is better than the battles

grievances.text: karen had a go at me about the printer
next door has had the leaf blower out since eight
forty minutes on hold with the insurance company
truck failed inspection over a bulb i already replaced
grievances.invite: you got a garage you trust

grievances.text: stood at a till for ten minutes because the card machine went down
grievances.invite: you get out of the shop okay

grievances.text: somebody rang at seven to sell me solar panels i do not need

stories.body: my grandfather's axe hung in the garage for twenty years. the head was fine, the handle was rotten
stories.point: i could have bought a new one for less than the handle cost. that was never the point of it

stories.body: my first deer, i was fifteen and i missed it clean. my uncle did not say a word the whole way home
stories.point: he told me later that a man who laughs at your miss will not be there for your next one

stories.body: i spent a weekend reading about how templeos was built. one man, one compiler, everything from scratch
stories.point: you do not need a team to make something real. you need to not stop

stories.body: i was in the building the night they lifted the cup in ninety-four. i did not sit down once
stories.point: you do not get many nights like that, so you take them when they come

stories.body: i hatched a charmander on a long drive with my nephew asleep in the back. took me three hours of walking
stories.point: he does not remember it. i have never told him it mattered

stories.body: the printer at work was never broken. wrong tray, every time, for two years
stories.point: i fixed it in four minutes and let her keep the story about the printer

plans.why: the rifle has been apart for a month and i want it sighted in before the season
there is a bench under all of that and i would like to see it again
the kid has never been to the garden and i want to be there when he sees it
the old one leaned for two years and i am not doing that again

activities.doing: moving my plants round so they all get a turn at the window
activities.phase: the little one has a new leaf coming
activities.why: they do not ask for much and they still do their best

activities.doing: rewatching code lyoko for the fourth time
activities.phase: the bit where aelita is finally out of the towers
activities.why: it is the one thing i can watch when i am tired

activities.doing: writing a tiny program that keeps track of my plants
activities.phase: it keeps calling one of them unknown plant
activities.why: i wanted to see if i could

activities.doing: sitting at the station with a coffee, watching the trains
activities.phase: there is a freight one that comes through about now
activities.why: they always turn up. i like that
activities.invite: is there a line near you?

activities.doing: rearranging the little shelf of cute things
activities.short: moving things about on my shelf
activities.phase: the frog has to be in the middle or it looks wrong
activities.why: it makes the room feel nicer
activities.invite: do you have a shelf like that?

grievances.text: the train was late again and i did not want to make a fuss
someone said my little program was pointless. i know it is
grievances.invite: do people do that to you

grievances.text: i said something silly on a call and i thought about it all evening
one of my plants is drooping and i do not know what i did
grievances.invite: do you know what that means

stories.body: the first program i wrote did nothing except print my name, and i sat watching it for ten minutes
stories.point: nobody saw it, but i had made a thing that worked

stories.body: i waited an hour at the station in the rain for a freight train and it never came
stories.point: i did not mind. it was quiet and nobody asked me anything

stories.body: i thought i had killed my little fern and i kept watering the pot anyway
stories.point: it came back in the spring and i cried a bit, which is silly

stories.body: i found the code lyoko theme on an old video and sat there grinning like an idiot
stories.point: some things stay exactly where you left them

plans.what: put up a second little shelf
plans.why: the frog has outgrown the first one
there is a freight one at nine and i keep missing it

plans.what: put the fern in a bigger pot
plans.why: he has been in that pot since i got him
